Return complete repository-relative file paths and complete symbol IDs exactly as stored. When the question asks which files, symbols or modules, return each distinct one once unless it asks for occurrences.

events.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT callee_symbol_id AS symbol_id
FROM auto_ontology_code.code.calls
WHERE caller_symbol_id IN (
    SELECT symbol_id
    FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbols
    WHERE name = 'create_graph'
)
AND call_kind = 'callback'
AND callee_symbol_id IS NOT NULL
AND callee_symbol_id NOT IN (
    SELECT symbol_id
    FROM auto_ontology_code.code.symbols
    WHERE name = 'create_graph'
);
